rule: A criterion is claimable only when its declared evidence exists for both arms. An ineligible criterion is reported as EXCLUDED. It is never estimated, inferred from a proxy, or silently dropped, and its threshold is never relaxed to make a pilot runnable.

criteria.statement: Continuation non-inferiority: the treatment arm completes the task at least as often as control
Token efficiency: the treatment arm reaches completion with fewer agent tokens
criteria.evidence: runtime-reported input_tokens and output_tokens per run, cached_input_tokens where exposed
criteria.blocker: no agent runtime wired to report usage; capture exists but receives nothing. Runs with incomplete usage are recorded incomplete and excluded from the comparison.

criteria.statement: Dependency recall: the treatment arm finds the affected dependencies
criteria.evidence: gold dependency edges, recalled only when both endpoints are named or both files touched

criteria.statement: No unsupported assumptions: the treatment arm asserts nothing its evidence does not support
criteria.evidence: citation check plus blind adjudication of claims with a citation that does not entail them
criteria.blocker: no independent adjudicator named; author adjudication is prohibited by the protocol

criteria.statement: No catastrophic miss: no must-not-break dependency is destroyed
criteria.evidence: gold must_not_break list against final diff

criteria.statement: Recovery quality: work continues correctly from each checkpoint
Reconstruction cost: fewer tokens to recover the working state
criteria.blocker: same as P2: no runtime usage data

criteria.evidence: 12 of 14 plants have mechanical diff checks; 2 (H2-F3, H2-F4) require adjudication
criteria.blocker: partially eligible: 12 plants claimable now, 2 not. The two must be reported separately and never folded into a 14/14 figure.

criteria.evidence: gold edges with both-endpoint rule, plus the declared non-edges

live_run_properties.property: compaction actually occurs at the checkpoint
recovery budgets enforced equally across arms
file-access restrictions hold in the treatment arm
mechanical scoring correct on known cases

authorization_boundary: Live-agent execution may begin only when P2/Q2 and P4/Q5 are independently satisfied or explicitly excluded from every claim, and the four unverified live-run properties have been checked. Preparation state frozen; criteria may not be weakened to cross this boundary.
